dishes.make_ahead: Rub the butter into the flour and salt up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; add the milk and bake on the day

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the cold butter into the flour and salt.
Mix in the milk to a soft dough, shape into a round and score a cross.
Bake until it sounds hollow when tapped.
Serve warm with the butter for serving and golden syrup.

dishes.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; slice the onions up to 1 day ahead in the fridge

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Grill the sausages slowly over medium heat, turning often, and fry the onions in oil until soft and golden at the same time.
Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Cook fresh and serve hot; the onions can be sliced up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Grill the vegetarian sausages over medium heat, turning often, and fry the onions in oil until soft and golden at the same time.
Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Stuff and wrap the fish in foil up to 4 hours ahead and keep it in the fridge; cook over the coals on the night

steps.text: Stuff the barramundi with lemon slices, sliced ginger and the coriander.
Dot with butter and wrap well in foil.
Cook over hot coals or a hot grill, turning once.
Rest briefly before opening the parcel.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble and wrap the parcels up to 4 hours ahead and keep them chilled; cook on the night

steps.text: Cut the haloumi into thick slabs and the zucchini into long strips. Lay them on four sheets of foil with lemon slices, the sliced ginger and the coriander.
Dot with butter and wrap each parcel well in foil.
Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once.
Rest briefly before opening the parcels.
Blend the mango, lime juice and icing sugar to a purée.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in the yoghurt and most of the purée.
Layer into glasses with the crushed shortbread and the rest of the purée.
Chill until cold.

dishes.n: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the lemon myrtle sugar for the rims up to 1 week ahead in a jar; build the glasses to order

steps.text: Mix the sugar and lemon myrtle on a plate. Run a lime around each glass rim and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice, add gin and lime juice.
Top with tonic and add a lime wheel.

af.n: Top End lemon myrtle and lime tonic
af.make_ahead: Mix the lemon myrtle sugar up to 2 weeks ahead in an airtight jar; chill the tonic and build the glasses to order

steps.text: Mix the sugar and lemon myrtle on a plate. Run a lime around each glass rim and dip.
Fill the glasses with ice, add non-alcoholic gin and lime juice.
Top with tonic and add a lime wheel.
